exposure: higher maternal BMI at first antenatal care visit
maternal BMI at first antenatal care visit
cohort: Pregnant women at 20 weeks' gestation or less who visited public health facilities for antenatal health checkups between November 2015 and January 2016 in Darkhan-Uul Province, Mongolia
finding: Higher maternal BMI at first antenatal care visit, higher gestational weight gain, older maternal age, and lower gestational age at delivery were associated with cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: Higher maternal BMI at the first antenatal care visit was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section delivery in Mongolia.
